statement: MONQWENSOR v1 (Qwen2.5-1.5B, mean-pooled last layer, 1536-dim, centred cosine) over 321 centre records: the one checked cross-field join (neuron segmental growth = phylogenetic trees, (2n-3)!!) ranks 1322 of 39028 cross-program pairs (top 3.4%). The top pairs are records that share boilerplate (Lean file paths, the word checked), not shared mathematics. As a link finder it is weak in this form; the sequence matcher found the same join exactly.

MONQWENSOR v2 (boilerplate stripped before embedding; records that state the known join excluded): the checked join (neuron segmental growth = phylogenetic trees) ranks 495 of 40612 cross-program pairs (top 1.2%, up from top 3.4% in v1). Its second-ranked pair is the same theorem recorded under two programs (three-qubit CKW), so it does find shared content; the first-ranked pair is still boilerplate.
